newsitem.title: HONG KONG: National Elec sells HK$137 mln property.
newsitem.headline: National Elec sells HK$137 mln property.

text.p: National Electronics Holdings Ltd said it had agreed to sell 7,952 square feet of residential units at Convention Plaza on Hong Kong Island to a third party for HK$137.17 million, making a profit of HK$37.67 million.
The property and electronics concern said it bought the units in November 1996 for HK$99.50 million.
The company said it had in October sold two office units in Admiralty Centre in Central to the third party for HK$101.60 million, realising a profit of HK$51.14 million.
Its shares edged up one cent to HK$0.52 in mid-morning.
